# Longbridge Earnings

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. A beat can still sink a stock on weak guidance, and a summary card is a starting point for reading, not a decision. Curated by Skill Harbor: the earnings skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself, covering US, Hong Kong and A-share names. Before the release, it runs a preview: a review of the guidance given last quarter, recent events since then, the questions analysts pressed on the last call, and a key-things-to-watch framework for the upcoming print. After the release, the default is a fast in-chat summary card built from a single bundled collector script (pure Python standard library) that fetches snapshot, income statement, consensus against actuals, EPS forecasts, quote, valuation multiples, institutional ratings, segments, news and candles in parallel: a core KPI table graded beat or miss against estimates, revenue by segment, six to eight quarters of revenue and margin trend, a thesis status read, the street's rating distribution and target range, next-quarter consensus, and a one-line risk list. Ask explicitly and it expands into a full Markdown research report with segment and margin analysis, guidance review, a model update and a three-method valuation with the math shown.
